Dry Van and Reefer coordination

Dispatch coordination built around carrier control.

Dry Van dispatch coordination follows the signed carrier-specific agreement. Reefer coordination may be added for approved trucks after a written amendment, specific authorization, and capacity review; temperature monitoring and guarantees are excluded.

LOAD OPTIONS

Review before deciding

Discuss load information and operating fit before the carrier decides whether to proceed.

COMMUNICATION

Coordinate the details

Assist with agreed communications and shipment updates using the authorized workflow.

DOCUMENTS

Carrier keeps control

The carrier reviews and signs its own Rate Confirmation. Do not email tax, bank, driver, insurance, or shipment documents.

What this service does not promise

  • No guaranteed loads, revenue, rate per mile, savings, detention payment, or service outcome.
  • No live GPS tracking, ELD monitoring, safety monitoring, or 24/7 response commitment.
  • No automatic load acceptance or authority to sign a Rate Confirmation for the carrier.
  • Reefer coordination requires a signed amendment, truck review, written authorization, and capacity confirmation; it does not include temperature monitoring or guarantees.
